extraInstructions: IMPORTANT: You MUST import and use BOTH audioManager AND speechManager. Import speechManager from '../../../lib/sim-engine/speech'. Use audioManager.play() for sound effects (valid: pickup, drop-correct, drop-wrong, tap, success, error, celebration, hint). Use speechManager.speak() for spoken teaching slide narration, challenge questions, correct/incorrect feedback, and hints. The game must teach: (1) Data vs information — data is raw facts, numbers, symbols without context (90, 80, 70 — could be marks, temperatures, prices). Information is processed, organised, meaningful data (marks with student names = report card). Like uncooked rice vs cooked biryani. (2) Data storage units — bit = smallest unit, holds 0 or 1 (like an electric switch on/off). Byte = 8 bits, stores one character (letter A, digit 5). KB = 1024 bytes. MB = 1024 KB. GB = 1024 MB. TB = 1024 GB. (3) Computer memory — RAM (Random Access Memory): volatile, temporary workspace, loses ALL data when power off. ROM (Read Only Memory): non-volatile, permanent, stores startup instructions, keeps data without power. (4) Storage devices — HDD (Hard Disk Drive): spinning magnetic platters, large capacity, low cost. SSD (Solid State Drive): no moving parts, flash memory, faster, lighter. USB flash drive: small, portable, plug and play. CD: optical disc, read by laser. DVD: like CD but holds more data. Cloud storage: stored on remote servers, accessed via Internet. Internal: inside computer (HDD, SSD). External: portable (USB, CD, DVD, cloud). Misconceptions: 'data and information are the same' (data is RAW and unprocessed, information is PROCESSED and meaningful — they are different stages), 'RAM keeps data when the computer is off' (RAM is VOLATILE — it loses ALL data when power is turned off, only ROM and storage devices keep data), 'a byte is smaller than a bit' (a byte is LARGER — 1 byte = 8 bits), 'SSD and HDD are the same' (SSD has NO moving parts and uses flash memory, HDD has spinning magnetic platters — SSD is faster), 'cloud storage is inside your computer' (cloud storage is on REMOTE servers accessed via Internet — it is NOT inside your computer). Default width=720, height=560. Use named export (export function ComputerMemoryGame), NOT export default. Export interface ComputerMemoryGameProps with width?, height?, onComplete?: (score: number) => void. Use double quotes for ALL strings containing apostrophes. Use 'currentChallenge' as variable name, NOT 'challenge'. Auto-hint timer MUST be exactly 10000ms.
